chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Wartime road work in cold winters with Barnet
summary: He recalls the road trips through Ohio, Saginaw, Chicago and Minneapolis in bitter winters.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How did you like working in that band?
It was good. But the only thing was the winter was mostly... Winters were bad there.
Yeah, war-time. And we played, you know, all

the towns in Ohio, Mansfield and all those places -- and it was very cold in the winter. To add fuel to the fire, we drove up to Saginaw, Michigan...! And then to make it worse... Have you ever been to Minneapolis in the winter-time?
No. I've been in Chicago in the winter-time.
